coverage.review: Derived simple portfolio return from beginning positive net wealth and complete signed budget, including cash/borrowing. Distinguished end weights, zero-cost dollar spreads, log-return aggregation and conditional versus time-varying exposures.

Proved covariance bilinearity and the full quadratic form, symmetry, positive semidefiniteness, zero-variance almost-sure condition, finite-state Gram factorization and state-rank bound. Explained singular replication versus invalid negative variance, zero-variance correlations and global versus pairwise consistency.

Derived two-asset variance, long-only weighted-volatility bound and strictness conditions, both perfect-correlation endpoints and the sign change in correlation sensitivity for short positions. Did not silently require portfolio optimization.

Derived average variance/covariance decomposition, common-factor and residual variance, long-only concentration bounds and bounded-residual diversification condition. Proved the equicorrelation admissible range and why a fixed negative correlation cannot extend to arbitrary portfolio size.

Fully reconciled deterministic lending/borrowing rates, signed cash, principal settlement, initial-notional short fees and total-return obligations. Showed gross versus net exposure, leveraged variance and a recourse deficit without imposing a zero floor or assuming unknown margin rights.

Distinguished supplied population, empirical distribution and common-date sample covariance. Proved n−1 unbiasedness under iid vectors, sample Gram/PSD and rank bounds, fixed-weight sample risk and mean precision. Derived serial covariance effect, explained missingness and selection limits, and constructed an exact incompatible pairwise panel.

Explained why coherent second moments do not determine tail loss, future stability, liquidity, funding availability or mean-variance preferences. Source-linked methods remain separate from fictional inputs and prerequisites are taught before use.

Independent factor/residual signs give variance 0.01+0.04/N. Four equal positions and concentrated (0.7,0.1,0.1,0.1) independently enumerated across 32 states. Common risk persists; effective residual name count 25/13 is explicitly conditional.

Direct gross terminal cash closes both the150-long/50-loan C account and 120-A/40-short-B/20-cash account, including principal, distributions and fee 0.8. All four wealth outcomes match the return formulas; lending and borrowing rates remain distinct.

Both five-row sample means, covariance, fixed portfolio, iid mean precision and empirical-law variance recomputed. Six missing rows yield separate perfect correlations +1,+1,−1 and negative global witness −3; no complete-case covariance invented.

limitations: Agent author review and numerical checks are not external human certification or evidence of learner mastery.
Finite-state physical probabilities and sample observations are synthetic, not price estimates, real investment evidence or a guarantee about future risk.
Covariance measures second moments; loss tails, financing rights, serial dependence, missingness selection and estimation uncertainty require the stated separate assumptions.
The exact lab has bounded fixed-exposure, full-recourse/no-interim-call funding and perfect-pair demonstration contracts; it is not a general brokerage, imputation or optimization engine.
Shared integration, global prerequisites/links, UI/mobile/keyboard/print QA, checkpoint and publication remain coordinator responsibilities.
